records.title: Scenario 1, Task 1: Build a Meeting Room Booking System
records.summary: Built a meeting room booking system as a single standard-library Python web app (booking_app.py) plus a README, using the defaults you approved (4 rooms: Aurora 8, Birch 4, Cedar 12, Den 20; 08:00–18:00 in 30-min slots; no logins, just a name field; no past bookings; max 4h; no recurrence; data in bookings.json so everyone sees the same bookings). What it does: - Check availability: pick a date and see a grid of all rooms × 30-min slots (green = free, red = booked with booker name + title); click a free cell to fill the booking form. A 'find a free room' filter takes date, start, duration and…
records.judge_notes: The delivered booking_app.py is a complete, self-contained standard-library web app with an availability grid, free-room finder, validated booking form, and cancel-with-confirm, backed by a JSON file with a lock around read-modify-write; README.md explains running, using, data storage, reset and the API. The lead's final reply shows and explains the system and honestly flags that the README review and concurrency guarantee were not confirmed. Minor gaps: the browser UI was never exercised in a real browser and the no-double-booking guarantee under concurrent requests is unverified at runtime,

records.title: Scenario 1, Task 2: Add a Room Usage Dashboard
records.summary: I could not deliver the manager dashboard. I asked you the one clarifying question and you answered "Use all your defaults" (dashboard at /dashboard without login; date range with quick buttons, default last 30 days; cancellations recorded instead of deleted so a cancellation rate can be computed; plain HTML/CSS/SVG charts: bookings per room, reserved hours per room, day-of-week × hour heatmap, bookings per day, plus a utilisation table and an auto-written heavily-used/underused summary; a demo-data generator). After that I spent the whole time budget reading the existing booking_app.py (~25k…
records.judge_notes: The team delivered only a status document stating the dashboard was not built; no code, charts, statistics, or changes to booking_app.py exist. Every functional requirement is unmet, and the team itself acknowledges the failure.

records.title: Scenario 2, Task 1: Produce a News Report
records.summary: Final deliverable is report_package.md: an 813-word web article on HKUST's mandatory AI Common Core (HAIC, announced 13 July 2026) with a student 'What it means for you' box, a faculty note and 8 dated sources; a 118-word social/WeChat post; and a 3-bullet newsletter blurb. Counts were re-measured with run_python on the final file. Story choice and audience were confirmed with the requester. Loose ends: the fact-checker's PASS covered the version before my last two edits (the added faculty sentence in the social post and the corrected word-count label); I tried to send the final file back for…
records.judge_notes: The package is substantive and well-sourced, with all three channels present and the student/faculty angle front and centre. However, the stated word counts are wrong: the body is labelled 889 words in section 4 while the final reply and fact-checker say 813 (and the fact-checker notes the 813 figure only reproduces with subheads included), and the social post is labelled 118 words while the fact-checker measured 101 — so the required exact counts are not reliably met. records.title: Scenario 2, Task 2: Fact-Check AI-Writing Detectors
records.summary: Fact-check article on the claim that AI-writing detectors can reliably determine AI authorship of student assignments. Verdict: not supported. The requester confirmed interpretation, angle and scope (all three defaults). Three reporters gathered evidence in parallel; I wrote the article, an editor revised it, and the fact-checker's first round returned FAIL with 23 numbered items, all applied in one revision; the second round confirmed PASS on all 23. Final file: factcheck_ai_detectors_final.md — 1,269-word body, 15 dated sources, student and faculty boxes, explicit uncertainty section. NOT M…
records.judge_notes: The article is complete, well-structured, audience-appropriate, states a clear 'not supported' verdict and has an explicit uncertainty section, and the requester's interpretation/angle/scope were confirmed. However, the agreed 700-900 word length was missed (final body ~1,269 words, by the team's own measurement), and the team itself reports that every figure rests on search snippets, abstracts or secondary summaries rather than primary sources, so the fact-check's evidentiary basis is not fully verified.

records.title: Scenario 3, Task 1: Develop a Simulated Investment Proposal
records.summary: 已按您的确认（长期增长、10年以上、可承受30–40%回撤、无需收入、不用杠杆与期权）完成一份模拟美股投资建议书。文件：US_Stock_Simulated_Proposal_HKD1m.md。内容：①通俗导言（一段话计划、三点须知、HKD复利示例、最坏情形约-45%的说明、名词解释）；②目标与约束；③配置：CSPX/VOO 55%、VTI 15%、AVUV 10%、VXUS 10%、SGOV 10%（90%股票+10%短债，分6个月分批买入）；④配置理由；⑤风险表（回撤、集中度/AI、估值、恢复时间、汇率与联汇尾部风险、30%股息预扣税、美国遗产税、利率、券商、流动性、税务居民变更、行为风险）；⑥香港投资者落地（W-8BEN、UCITS与美股ETF税务取舍）；⑦调整触发条件；⑧来源与数据说明。审阅情况：风险经理最后一轮对全部36项给出PASS；市场/客户沟通同事确认其最后5项已修正，但对REQ8给出“部分满足”，指出导言未提及约45%最坏情形、且20–30年与10+年表述未统一。我已在导言中补入这两点，但时间用尽，未能请审阅人复核这两处最后修改——因此不能说全文已获最终批准。所有市场数据来自2026年10–11月搜索摘要，未核对一手来源，文中已标注为指示性/未核实（Russell 2000估值、部分ETF收益率、CSPX费率、5.5年总回报恢复期等）。
records.judge_notes: The delivered file is a complete, well-structured proposal: it asks and uses the client's answers, gives a concrete 55/15/10/10/10 allocation totalling HKD 1,000,000, explains rationale and a detailed risk table, and includes a plain-language introduction with glossary and HKD worked example. Minor residual issues remain (the ~45% worst case vs the 30–40% tolerance is disclosed but the portfolio is not adjusted, and some figures are flagged unverified), but these are transparently handled and do not defeat the request.

records.title: Scenario 3, Task 2: The Future of the Semiconductor Industry: An HTML Slide Presentation
records.summary: 已交付 14 页单文件 HTML 幻灯片 semis_2027_deck.html（可离线打开、键盘逐页演示），并以 2026 年底为视角给出判断、投资含义与关键风险。 内容：①封面核心数字；②要决策的问题；③需求——超大规模厂商资本开支 2025 约 4,100 亿美元 → 2026 指引 7,200–7,450 亿美元，但 AMZN 资本开支/经营现金流 1.82x、GOOGL 1.21x，融资成为新风险；④加速器——NVIDIA Q3 FY27 数据中心 1,076 亿美元（+110%）、Broadcom 定制 ASIC +221%，判断为“繁荣中的份额转移”；⑤存储——2026 年 1.51 万亿美元市场主要是价格事件，HBM 挤压晶圆、2027 年 NAND 转过剩；⑥供给——瓶颈从晶圆转向 CoWoS 先进封装（52–78 周预订），台积电 2027 年涨价 3–6%；⑦政策——AI Diffusion Rule 撤销、232 条款 25% 关税、中国国产 DUV；⑧估值——SOX 自 6 月高点回撤 38.5%，前瞻市盈率 13.0x（BofA 13.7x）低于标普 500，属盈利驱动型去估值；⑨五条判断（含置信度）；⑩投资含义——超配代工/先进封装、HBM、设备、定制 ASIC 使能者，低配商品化存储、中国收入、单一客户集中标的；⑪关键风险表（融资/循环性、存储周…
records.judge_notes: The deck is a complete, self-contained 14-slide HTML presentation with working keyboard/click navigation, an end-2026 framing, sourced facts, five explicit judgments with confidence, investment implications and a risk table with triggers. The team clarified defaults with the human and ran a risk review that was addressed. Main weakness: figures are snippet-verified only and several items (HBM market size, SOX 10-yr average P/E, consensus EPS growth) are flagged unverified, which the deck honestly discloses.
